sources.snippet: Schleich designs and manufactures toy figurines and small play figures intended to spark imaginative storytelling. The products are crafted to be safe, durable, and highly detailed, providing tangible play objects families can trust. Headquartered in Munich, Bavaria, Germany, the company traces its roots to 1935 and operates as a mid-sized manufacturing firm with a global reach, serving customers in more than 60 countries.
